headline: Executive order aimed at expanding artificial intelligence education for young people in the United States.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order directs the federal government to promote teaching about artificial intelligence (AI) to American students. No official summary was provided, so the specific programs, funding, or agency duties it creates are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: The order is aimed at increasing young people's chances to learn about AI.
Schools and educators may see new federal efforts encouraging AI instruction, though the details are not stated in the title.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed April 23, 2025; executive orders generally take effect when signed unless they say otherwise.
